title: Chicken Tagine Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, this dish features marinated chicken cooked in a savory sauce with umami flavors.

ingredients.name: moroccan spice blend
ingredients.notes: or use a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

ingredients.name: rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: or substitute with apple cider vinegar

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the moroccan spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted red peppers, garlic, and ginger. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the umami sauce and rice vinegar. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the green onions. Serve hot over rice.
